title: A Massive, Clumpy Molecular Gas Distribution and Displaced AGN in Zw 3146
question: How is the molecular gas in the Zw 3146 BCG distributed relative to the X-ray cavities, and why are the molecular gas and the mm continuum (AGN) source offset?

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image the CO(1-0) cube and continuum
recipe.method: CASA pipeline calibration, uvcontsub continuum subtraction, clean imaging with Briggs weighting

recipe.goal: Measure the molecular gas systemic redshift
recipe.method: Extract a spectrum from a 3'' x 3'' region and fit a single Gaussian

recipe.goal: Derive total CO flux and molecular gas mass
recipe.method: Fit the integrated spectrum from a 13 x 13 kpc box with a single Gaussian and convert the integrated flux to mass with the X_CO relation

recipe.goal: Map integrated flux, velocity and FWHM pixel by pixel
recipe.method: Fit spectra from individual pixels (each averaged over a synthesized-beam-sized box) with up to two Gaussians
key_parameters: Monte Carlo with 10000 iterations, 5 sigma detection threshold for each component
assumptions: Instrumental broadening incorporated into the model

recipe.goal: Isolate the molecular extensions by subtracting the unresolved central source and fit clump spectra
recipe.method: Subtract a scaled, tophat-convolved beam image centred on the brightest pixel from the integrated flux map, then fit spectra of the clumps
key_parameters: Beam image convolved with a beam-shaped tophat kernel
assumptions: The central peak is an unresolved point source

recipe.goal: Measure the 3 mm continuum and fit its SED
recipe.method: Image line-free channels at 96.193 GHz in a 40'' square, fit a 2D Gaussian, then fit a power law to the SED with lower-frequency literature fluxes
key_parameters: Contours start at 3 sigma with sigma = 7.45 uJy/beam, steps of 4 sigma
assumptions: Power law S_nu proportional to nu^-alpha

recipe.goal: Quantify and check the gas-continuum offset
recipe.method: Compare CO and continuum peak positions; check against VLA positions and the DECaLS r-band stellar centre
assumptions: Offset cannot come from phase calibration because line and continuum share the same observation

recipe.goal: Identify X-ray cavities and derive their energetics
recipe.method: Apply a GGM filter to the Chandra image, manually identify cavities as ellipses, then compute enthalpy 4pV, ages and power from interpolated deprojected profiles
key_parameters: Volume from geometric mean of oblate and prolate geometries; 15% uncertainty in semiaxes a and b
assumptions: Cavity in pressure balance with the surrounding gas

recipe.goal: Test explanations for the gas-continuum offset
recipe.method: Chance-alignment probability from 1000 randomly populated fields; momentum-thrust acceleration from cavity D versus restoring acceleration of a singular isothermal sphere
assumptions: 31 GHz source density scaled to 100 GHz
